The prose describes the same system: the cells are stimulated with ultrasound to stimulate tumor cells, producing ultrasound-engineered[3] tumor-derived exosomes (US-EV) for the co-delivery of hematoporphyrin monomethyl ether (HMME) and YTHDF1 siRNA.[4]
